title: EXAMVAN Questions Contract v1
description: Canonical questions payload emitted by the SERVER to clients. Android and Go must consume this shape. Legacy aliases are accepted only as input and are normalized before storing or sending.

number.description: Unique 1-based question number. Invalid legacy numbers are replaced with the first unused positional number.

partial_scoring.description: Default true for multiple_choice, matching, true_false, and short_answer.

options.description: Compatibility mirror of choices for older Go consumers. Always identical to choices.

statements.description: true_false: one statement per row. short_answer: label/prompt for each answer field. If short_answer has multiple keys but no statements, the server generates Isian 1, Isian 2, ...

true_label.description: True/false only. Custom label for the TRUE answer (for example Sesuai). Empty means the client default.

false_label.description: True/false only. Custom label for the FALSE answer (for example Tidak Sesuai). Empty means the client default.

numbering.description: matching or short_answer. single = the whole card uses one question number; range = each left item or answer field consumes one number (N..N+span-1).

answer_order.description: short_answer only. ordered (default) matches answers by field index; any matches each key to any unused student answer.

key.description: Answer key. SERVER-ONLY: the public student endpoint strips this field before responding. short_answer accepts a string or an array of strings; matching uses item:item pairs; multiple_choice uses option letters.
